question: What is suggested as a way to maintain digital well-being?
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage emphasizes that unchecked algorithmic influence can reduce personal agency and create feedback loops.
 
• It suggests that digital well-being requires critical awareness of how we engage with algorithms, not blindly following them.
 
• Practicing critical engagement helps maintain autonomy, avoid passive consumption, and stay open to diverse perspectives.
 
• Other options like ignoring content, following only algorithms, or increasing screen time do not support healthy digital well-being.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** Ignore all content – Incorrect, complete disengagement is not suggested.
 
• **Option 2:** Follow only algorithmic suggestions – Incorrect, this reduces personal agency.
 
• **Option 4:** Increase screen time – Incorrect, more exposure does not ensure well-being.
